about: InMode Ltd. designs, develops, manufactures, and markets minimally invasive aesthetic medical products based on its proprietary radio frequency assisted lipolysis and deep subdermal fractional radiofrequency technologies in the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. It offers minimally invasive aesthetic medical products for various procedures, such as liposuction with simultaneous skin tightening, body and face contouring, and ablative skin rejuvenation treatments, as well as for use in women's health conditions and procedures.
